---
title: "_13_3_parallel_check"
format: html
---

```{r}

library(survey)
library(srvyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(haven)
library(tidyr)
library(srvyr) # surveyデータ処理用

# オブジェクトクリア
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
gdrive_dir <- "/Users/snakada/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-snakada@g.ecc.u-tokyo.ac.jp/マイドライブ/Peru_work/Peru_endes/spss"

# 結果保存先
save_path <- file.path(gdrive_dir, "output")

# 必要な関数読み込み
source("_tool_SaveLabel.R")

# ステップ1: 元データの読み込み
df_org <- readRDS(
    file.path(gdrive_dir, "output","all_data_merged.rds")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(v021) & !is.na(v022) & !is.na(sampling_weight_trimmed))

# 変数ラベルをメモリに保存したうえでラベル消去
labels_memory <- save_labels_to_memory(df_org)
df_org <- remove_labels(df_org)

# キーテーブルの作成（グラフ作成次のグループ分けに利用）
key_table <- distinct(
  df_org,
  year,
  state,
  treatment_group,
  treated_status,
  year_treated,
  treatment_start,
  treatment_group,
  analysis_grp,
  group_treated
)

# 分析に利用する変数名の抽出
variable_for_analysis <- names(df_org)
variable_for_analysis <- variable_for_analysis[grepl("^[a-zA-Z]{2}_|^enaho_|^juntos_", variable_for_analysis)]

# データ形式をロングに変換
df_long <- df_org %>%
  mutate(
    across(all_of(variable_for_analysis),
           ~ as.numeric(as.character(.)))
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(variable_for_analysis),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "value"
  ) 

# 孤立PSU問題に対処
options(survey.lonely.psu = "adjust")

# Survey designオブジェクトの作成
svy_obj <- svydesign(
  ids = ~v021,          # Primary Sampling Unit (クラスター)
  strata = ~v022,       # 層化変数
  weights = ~sampling_weight_trimmed,
  data = df_long,
  nest = TRUE           # 入れ子構造
)

# srvyrオブジェクトに変換
svy_obj_srvyr <- as_survey_design(svy_obj)

# ステップ3: グループ別・年次別の加重平均を計算
summary_by_treatment <- svy_obj_srvyr %>%
  group_by(state, year, variable) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = survey_mean(value, na.rm = TRUE,),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 全国平均
summary_national <- svy_obj_srvyr %>%
  group_by(year, variable) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_value = survey_mean(value, na.rm = TRUE,),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 結果は通常のデータフレーム（tibble）として返される
# 列：treatment_group, year, mean_stunted, mean_stunted_low, mean_stunted_upp
head(plot_data)


# ステップ3: グループ別・年次別の加重平均を計算
plot_data <- svy_obj_srvyr %>%
  mutate(
    nt_ch_stunt_num = case_when(
      nt_ch_stunt == "Yes" ~ 1,
      nt_ch_stunt == "No" ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    treatment_group = zap_labels(treatment_group) %>% as.factor()
  ) %>%
  # filter(year <= 2008) %>%
  group_by(state, year) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_stunted = survey_mean(nt_ch_stunt_num, na.rm = TRUE, vartype = "ci"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 結果は通常のデータフレーム（tibble）として返される
# 列：treatment_group, year, mean_stunted, mean_stunted_low, mean_stunted_upp
head(plot_data)

# ステップ4: ggplotで可視化
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = year, y = mean_stunted, 
                      color = treatment_group, 
                      group = treatment_group)) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mean_stunted_low, ymax = mean_stunted_upp, 
                  fill = treatment_group),
              alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +  # 信頼区間を半透明で表示
  labs(
    title = "stunting rate by treatment status over years",
    x = "year",
    y = "stunting rate (%)",
    color = "treatment_group",
    fill = "treatment_group"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
